analogy.rationale: Cannabinoid receptors (CNR1/CNR2) are barely expressed in most of these cell lines, so agonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other cannabinoid-receptor ligands and GPCR-targeting agents, with FAAH inhibitors and TRPV agonists sharing endocannabinoid-related biology but likely also weak effects.
